title: nEmp - pleasant things
html:
Graph connections

Root

  • nEm - favor

Meaning

pleasant things · Lemma نَعْمَة

Surahs (2)

  • 044 Ad-Dukhan
  • 073 Al-Muzzammil

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali) + Urdu. Showing up to 10 verses in (web app shows all).

44:27 · 044 Ad-Dukhan

وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

Word in this verse: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ — And pleasant things

English (Sahih International): And comfort wherein they were amused.

English (Yusuf Ali): And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور آرام کی چیزیں جن میں عیش کیا کرتے تھے

Open on Quran.com

73:11 · 073 Al-Muzzammil

وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

Word in this verse: ٱلنَّعْمَةِ — (of) the ease

English (Sahih International): And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

English (Yusuf Ali): And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور مجھے ان جھٹلانے والوں سے جو دولتمند ہیں سمجھ لینے دو اور ان کو تھوڑی سی مہلت دے دو
